info.name: RCB Matka · Player App API
info.description:
Every route of the **player API** (`api.rcbmatka.com`), the backend of the RCB Matka Android app.

The folders follow the app the way a player meets it: **Sign in**, **Home**, **Bidding** (one request per game on each board: main market, Starline, King Jackpot), **My Bids and results**, **Funds: add money**, **Funds: withdraw**, **Passbook**, **Notifications**, **Support chat**, **Refer and earn**, **Info pages**, then the old routes that are switched off, and **Sign out** last.

## Start here

1. Pick an environment (top right): **RCB Matka · LIVE** or **RCB Matka · LOCAL**.
2. Send **Sign in (start here) › Sign in as the player** (`{{player_mobile}}` / `{{player_password}}`). The token is saved in `{{player_token}}`, and every request here sends `Authorization: Bearer {{player_token}}` (set on the collection).
3. Send **Load the player's profile and balance**: it saves `{{player_user_id}}`, which many bodies and queries carry, as the app does.

The market lists on **Home** save the first market that still takes bids (`{{market_id}}`, `{{starline_market_id}}`, `{{jackpot_market_id}}`), which the bid requests use.

## How the player API knows who is asking

- Some routes check the session with the auth middleware: the token must be the player's current session, and the account must be active.
- Others read the token inside the controller.
- A few are open: the login, the app settings, the contact numbers, and the time table.

The app sends the token on everything, so this collection does too. Each request's description says which kind it is. Bodies are sent the way the app sends them: form fields (`x-www-form-urlencoded`) for most screens, JSON for the bids, the histories and the withdraw routes.

## Location headers

While **geo restriction** is on (console: **Access › Allowed States**), the API wants the phone's state in an `X-Geo-State` header, and answers `451` without an allowed one. Put a state in the environment's `{{geo_state}}` (for example `Maharashtra`). Every request then sends it, as the app does with the phone's GPS. Leave it empty when geo restriction is off.

## Writes are switched off on LIVE

Every request that changes data checks the environment's `allow_writes` first. When it is not `true` (LIVE ships with `false`), the request is **not sent**, and the Console says why. On LIVE, bids take real stakes from the player's wallet and **Request a withdrawal** moves real money; their descriptions say **Moves money**.

## Reading the answers

Most routes answer **HTTP 200** even when they refuse: `success` is `"1"` (done), or `"0"` / `"2"` / `"4"` with a `message` ("Market Closed", "Insufficient balance"…). The old sign-up and MPIN routes answer **410**; the folder **Switched off** says why each one is off.

## Where this comes from

Made from `api.rcbmatka.com/app/routes/user.routes.js`, the controllers, and the app's screens (`application code/rcb_matka/lib`). It covers every route the server registers, plus `/health`. Generated by `postman/tools/build` and checked by `postman/tools/verify`, which runs every request against local copies of the services. See `postman/README.md`.

item.name: Sign in as the player · user-login

request.description:
The login screen's LOGIN button: checks the mobile number and password and returns a 24-hour session token. One session per player: this replaces the token the player's phone holds.

**Who:** public, no token. After 10 failed tries from one IP or for one mobile within 15 minutes it refuses until the window passes (counted per API process).

**Fields:** `mobile` and `password` are required; `device_id`, `device_uid`, `device_info`, `fcm_token`, `lat`, `long`, `state` are optional (see each field). Sent form-encoded, as the app does.

**Returns:** 200 `{success:'1', message:'Login successful', token, data:{id, username, mobile, device_id, credit, has_received_bonus}}` (no `user_id`: the profile request saves it). Refusals are 200 `success:'0'`: `Mobile and password are required`, `Invalid mobile number or password` (same answer for an unknown number), `Too many failed attempts. Please try again in N minutes.`, an inactive account (`reason:'account_inactive'`, `support`), a geo or IP block (`blocked:true`, `reason`, `support`). 500 `{success:'0', message}` on a server error.

**Side effects** (flagged as a read so a read-only run can still sign in): stores the new token and any device ids / FCM token sent, refreshes the console's sealed password copy, decides the joining bonus once and releases bonuses a deposit has already unlocked (`bonusEngine`), writes a `login_histories` row and the player's `last_ip` / `state`.

---
`POST /api/user-login`  
App: `lib/src/module/login/login_page.dart`  
Code: `api.rcbmatka.com/app/controllers/user.controller.js:606 (UserLogin)`

urlencoded.description: Required. The registered mobile number (10 digits).
Required. The player's password (bcrypt-checked).

Optional. The app's model-level phone id. When sent (and device_uid is empty) every OTHER account with this device_id and no device_uid is logged out, and it is stored on the player. Empty here so a run logs nobody else out.

Optional. The phone's own id (ANDROID_ID; 6 to 128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 : _ . -). When sent, other accounts with it are logged out; the one-joining-bonus-per-phone rule keys on it. Empty clears the stored one.
Optional. Phone model text for the login history (default 'Not provided').
Optional. The phone's Firebase push token; stored when not empty.
Optional. GPS latitude for the login history.
Optional. GPS longitude for the login history.

Optional. The Indian state the phone's GPS resolves to (e.g. Maharashtra). Checked against the geo rules only when geo restriction is on; empty then means 'location required'. Here it is {{geo_state}} from the environment.

request.description:

**Who:** the player in the Bearer token, checked in the controller: valid signature and still the current session (else 401 `Session expired. Please login again.`; no header 401 `{error:'Authorization header missing'}`; bad or expired token 401 `{error}`). The account status is not refused: an inactive player gets the profile plus `support` and the app shows "Account locked".

equals.message: Your profile, balance and app settings.

request.description:
My Profile's Save button: changes the player's display name and rewrites every copy of it. As wired it sends the current name, so the server answers `Username is already up to date` and changes nothing; type a new name to rename for real.

**Who:** the player in the Bearer token, checked by `authenticateJWT`: valid signature, still the player's current session, account active (401 `Invalid Token` or `Session expired. Please login again.`; 403 `reason:'account_inactive'` with `support`). No console permission.

**Fields:**
- `username` string, required: 3 to 12 characters after trimming; letters, digits, spaces, `.` and `_`.
- `_id` string: sent by the app, ignored.

**Returns:** 200 `{success:'1', message:'Username updated successfully', data:<player>, previous_username, updated_records}` or `message:'Username is already up to date'`; 400 `{success:'0', message}` for a name that breaks the rules (also when the CURRENT name does, e.g. longer than 12); 404 `User not found`; 500.

**Changes:** `users.username`; the name copied on `add_bank_accounts`, `add_bank_account_history`, `deposit_requests`, `withdraw_requests`, `wallets`, `game_loads`, `game_load_after_results`, `login_histories`, `ideaSubmits`, `ip_whitelist`; a `username_history` row (changed by 'User', with the IP).

item.name: Save the phone's push token · update-fcm-token

request.description:
Home sends the phone's Firebase token on every load so result and support pushes reach the phone. A run stores the test value, so pushes to the player's phone stop until the app sends its real token again (next Home load).

**Who:** the player whose `user_id` is in the Bearer token, read in the controller with `jwt.verify` only: no session or account-status check, so a logged-out or blocked player's token keeps working until it expires (24 h). No header: 401 `Authorization header missing`; a bad or expired token: 500 `{error}`. The route is an open path of the geo gate.

**Fields:**
- `fcm_token` string: the push token; stored as sent.

**Returns:** 200 `{success:'1', message:'Successfully'}`; 200 `{success:'2', message:'Invalid Details!'}` when the token's player no longer exists; 401 / 500 as above.

**Changes:** `users.fcm_token`.

request.description:
Change Password (menu and My Profile). As wired it sends the current password as the new one, which the server refuses (`New password must be different from your current password`, or the length rule), so a run neither changes the password nor ends the session. With a real new password the session ends: sign in again.

**Who:** the player in the Bearer token, checked by `authenticateJWT`: valid signature, still the player's current session, account active (401 `Invalid Token` or `Session expired. Please login again.`; 403 `reason:'account_inactive'` with `support`). No console permission.

**Fields:**
- `current_password` string, required: checked against the stored hash.
- `new_password` string, required: 8 to 12 characters, no whitespace, not the current password.
- `confirm_password` string, required: equal to `new_password`.
- `_id`: sent by the app, ignored (it used to choose the account).

**Returns:** 200 `{success:'1', logout:true, message:'Password changed successfully. Please login again with your new password.'}`. Refusals are 200 `success:'0'`: `Current password, new password and confirm password are required`, `Password must be 8 to 12 characters long`, `Password cannot contain spaces`, `New password and confirm password do not match`, `Current password is incorrect`, `New password must be different from your current password`, `No password is set on this account. Please contact support.`; 500 on a server error.

**Changes:** `users.password` (bcrypt), `password_copy` (the sealed copy shown in the console's All Players), `simple_password` removed, `token` cleared (the player is logged out everywhere).

item.description:
Where a session starts: the login screen (`module/login/login_page.dart`), My Profile (`profile_page.dart`), Change Password (`change_password.dart`) and the push-token update Home sends (`home_page.dart`). Run **Sign in as the player** first (saves `player_token`, `player_id`, `player_username`), then **Load the player's profile and balance** (saves `player_user_id`: the login answer has no `user_id`). Sign out is the last folder because it ends the session every other request uses.
The app posts these forms as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` and sends `X-Geo-Lat`, `X-Geo-Lng`, `X-Geo-State`, `X-Geo-Mock` on every call: they matter only when App Setting `geo_restriction_enabled` is "1" (then add `X-Geo-State: <an allowed state>`, or most requests answer 451 `blocked:true`).
Also uses: Load the contact details (Info pages); Get the next sign-up WhatsApp number, Get the player's support WhatsApp number (Home).

item.name: Home

request.description:
The Home main-market board (and the market filter of Bid History and Win History): today's main markets with their bidding state and today's result.

**Who:** the player in the Bearer token, checked by `authenticateJWT`: valid signature, still the player's current session, account active (401 `Invalid Token` or `Session expired. Please login again.`; 403 `reason:'account_inactive'` with `support`). No console permission.

**Fields:** none (`market_type` is read from the body and ignored).

**Returns:** 200 `{success:'1', message:'Market Fetch Successfully', data:[{id, market_name, market_id, type, open_time, close_time, open_result_time, close_result_time, betStatus, openstatus, closestatus, betStatusMsg, result}]}`; 200 `{success:'2', message:'Not Found'}` when none runs today; 500 `{error}`.
- Listed: `market_type` mainmarket, `show_in_app` 'yes' and today's weekday ticked; morning (opens before 12:00), afternoon (before 18:00), night, each by open time. Times are HH:mm IST.
- `openstatus` 'open' until the open time and until the open result is out; `closestatus` 'open' until the close time; `betStatus` 'open' while bidding is possible; `result` `***-**-***`, `128-1*-***` after the open result, `128-15-357` after both (all 'Close' then).

Bid on a single digit (main market) · bet-place

request.description:
Single Digit on a main market, as `module/games/single_digit_games/single_digit_view.dart` sends it: One digit, 0 to 9: the ank (last digit of the sum of a result pana's digits). Example: 5. Stake ₹10 per bid, ₹10 in all.

**Who:** the player in the Bearer token, checked in the controller: valid signature and still the current session (else 401 `Your session has expired. Please log in again.`); an inactive account gets 200 `success:'2'` `Your account is inactive. Please contact support.`

**Fields:**
- `market_type` string, required: `mainmarket` (one of `mainmarket`, `kingstarline`, `kingjackport`).
- `market_id` string, required: the market's `market_id` from Home's list (`{{market_id}}`).
- `game_session` string, required: 'open' here (taken until the market's open time, and refused once the open result is out) or 'close' (until the close time, refused once the close result is out).
- `bet_list` array, required, 1 to 1000 bids, each: `game_type_name` (`single_digit`), `bet_key` (the digit; integer or digit string), `bet_key1` (0), `bet_amount` (whole rupees within the game's min and max, see Load my payout rates). The `session` the app adds to each bid is ignored.
